faq.q: What is the origin of Aamilah?
faq.a: Aamilah is associated with Arabic. Feminine active participle of عَمِلَ (to work, to act).
Yes — the underlying form عاملة is Arabic.
Aamilah can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
